verdict.rationale: Buzz is a self-hostable team chat and collaboration platform, so message retention and legal holds are a fair compliance question. The evidence pack documents no retention-policy configuration, legal-hold mechanism, or eDiscovery export. Agent audit trails, six-month history search, and moderation reports are related features but not retention or hold controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can enforce message retention policies and legal holds for compliance and eDiscovery
